issue.title: Unified highlighter should respect no_match_size with number_of_fragments set to 0

labels.name: :Search Relevance/Highlighting
labels.description: How a query matched a document

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The unified highlighter returns the first sentence of the text when number_of_fragments
is set to 0 (full highlighting). This is a legacy of the removed postings highlighter
that was based on sentence break only. This commit changes this behavior in order
to respect the provided no_match_size value when number_of_fragments is set to 0.
This means that the behavior will be consistent for any value of the number_of_fragments option.

Closes #41066

issue.title: Elasticsearch 6 support

repository.name: digitalmarketplace-search-api
repository.description: API to handle interactions between the digitalmarketplace applications and search applications.

issue.body:
PR to [make search-api work with Elasticsearch 6](https://trello.com/c/BlYurEoJ/418-prepare-search-api-for-elasticsearch-6).

Tested with Elasticsearch 6.7.0.

Note that this merges into `elasticsearch-6` (not `master`).

Includes workaround for https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/41066, but hopefully it won't be needed!
